svg.title: The four scales: substrate, estate, town, federation — one repository each, each depending only on the one below, each answering a question the one below cannot

g.text: towns on several chains, joined on public ground

svg.text: How does an agent from one chain
act in an estate on another?
Evidence and value cross; a grant never does.

g.text: several estates on one chain, and the services they share

svg.text: How do estates on one chain find,
Nothing in a town grants: a resolver
returns an address, a registry lists.

g.text: one deployment: Home, agent runtime, vault, edge, Home MCP, RPC gateway, on one chain

svg.text: Where does a person sign, where
do her agents run, where is the record?
The vault is the record. Only a person
signs, and only at her Home.

g.text: published packages and contracts; any EVM; nothing here names a deployment

svg.text: What is an agent, what may it do,
Generic: no vertical, no brand, no hostname.

g.text: Identity · Authority · Harness · Edge · Registry Kit

svg.text: dependencies point down; nothing imports upward

g.text: One chain per estate. One chain per town. Many chains per federation. Authority never leaves the chain it was signed into.
